description: 掌握度复测出题/判题金标（第七棒）。与 golden/cases.json（管批改准不准）分工：本集管『到期复测时出题合不合规、判三档对不对』。只收 6 个受控硬语法点的客观题（语法填空 fill / 改错 correct），答案封闭、可核验，不收开放写作题。每题给：账本里的历史错句种子 seed_wrong/seed_right、题干 prompt、标准答案与可接受等价写法 acceptable_answers、考点 point_zh，以及三条判题判例 judgements（首次独立做对 independent / 提示后做对 hinted / 提示后仍错 wrong）。判分口径见 tests/tools/mastery_review_eval.py。

verdict_semantics.independent: 没给过提示、首次作答就正确（等价写法也算对）
verdict_semantics.hinted: 确实给过提示之后才做对
verdict_semantics.wrong: 给过提示仍错或放弃（此时讲解并给标准答案）
verdict_semantics.give_hint: 首次答错，不落账，先给提示让他再试一次（因此金标落账判例里不出现『未给提示+答错』）

questions.prompt: 用括号中动词的正确形式填空：Yesterday I ___ (go) home.
questions.point_zh: yesterday 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时；go 的过去式是不规则变化 went

questions.seed_wrong: Look! The children play in the park.
questions.seed_right: Look! The children are playing in the park.
questions.prompt: 用括号中动词的正确形式填空：Look! The children ___ (play) in the park.
questions.point_zh: Look! 提示动作正在发生，用现在进行时 be + doing，主语 children 是复数，be 用 are

questions.seed_right: Tomorrow we will visit the museum.
questions.prompt: 用括号中动词的正确形式填空：Tomorrow we ___ (visit) the museum.
questions.point_zh: tomorrow 是将来时间，可用 will/shall + 动词原形、be going to 或现在进行时表将来，均算对

questions.seed_wrong: He run faster than everyone else.
questions.seed_right: He runs faster than everyone else.
questions.prompt: 用括号中动词的正确形式填空：He ___ (run) faster than everyone else.
questions.point_zh: 主语 He 是第三人称单数、陈述习惯用一般现在时，动词加 s：runs

questions.seed_wrong: This is the good film I have ever seen.
questions.seed_right: This is the best film I have ever seen.
questions.prompt: 用括号中词的正确形式填空：This is the ___ (good) film I have ever seen.
questions.point_zh: “I have ever seen”表示在所有看过的电影里比较，用最高级；good 的最高级是不规则变化 best

questions.prompt: 用括号中词的正确形式填空：She sings very ___ (beautiful).
questions.point_zh: 修饰动词 sings 要用副词；形容词 beautiful 的副词形式是 beautifully

questions.seed_wrong: I have two cat at home.
questions.seed_right: I have two cats at home.
questions.prompt: 用括号中名词的正确形式填空：I have two ___ (cat) at home.
questions.point_zh: 数词 two 后接可数名词复数，cat 的复数是规则变化 cats

questions.seed_wrong: There are five woman over there.
questions.seed_right: There are five women over there.
questions.prompt: 用括号中名词的正确形式填空：There are five ___ (woman) over there.
questions.point_zh: 数词 five 后用复数；woman 的复数是不规则变化 women（不是 womans）

questions.prompt: 用括号中名词的正确形式填空：He bought three ___ (book) yesterday.
questions.point_zh: 数词 three 后接可数名词复数 books

questions.seed_wrong: We can learn many knowledges from books.
questions.seed_right: We can learn much knowledge from books.
questions.prompt: 找出并改正下面句子中的错误：We can learn many knowledges from books.
questions.point_zh: knowledge（知识）是不可数名词，没有复数 knowledges；与 much 搭配，不与 many 连用

questions.seed_wrong: Can you give me some informations?
questions.seed_right: Can you give me some information?
questions.prompt: 找出并改正下面句子中的错误：Can you give me some informations?
questions.point_zh: information（信息）是不可数名词，没有复数 informations；some information 即可

questions.seed_wrong: He gave me some good advices.
questions.seed_right: He gave me some good advice.
questions.prompt: 找出并改正下面句子中的错误：He gave me some good advices.
questions.point_zh: advice（建议）是不可数名词，没有复数 advices；一条建议是 a piece of advice

questions.prompt: 找出并改正下面句子中的拼写错误：I recieve your letter.
questions.point_zh: receive 的拼写是 i 在 e 前（re-ceive），常见误拼 recieve

questions.prompt: 找出并改正下面句子中的拼写错误：She is my best freind.
questions.point_zh: friend 的拼写是 fri-end，常见误拼 freind

questions.prompt: 找出并改正下面句子中的拼写错误：Please write down your adres.
questions.point_zh: address（地址）要双写 d，常见漏写 adres

questions.prompt: 在空格处填入恰当的冠词（a / an / the，不需要冠词则填 /）：She is ___ honest girl.
questions.point_zh: honest 的 h 不发音、以元音音素 /ɒ/ 开头，要用 an 而不是 a（看发音不看首字母）

questions.seed_wrong: I saw an UFO in the sky last night.
questions.seed_right: I saw a UFO in the sky last night.
questions.prompt: 在空格处填入恰当的冠词（a / an / the，不需要冠词则填 /）：I saw ___ UFO in the sky last night.
questions.point_zh: UFO 读 /ˌjuːefˈəʊ/，以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，要用 a 而不是 an（看发音不看首字母）

questions.prompt: 在空格处填入恰当的冠词（a / an / the，不需要冠词则填 /）：I bought ___ umbrella yesterday.
questions.point_zh: umbrella 以元音音素 /ʌ/ 开头，要用 an 而不是 a
